messages.text: What is eye diagram, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

In the provided evidence, an eye diagram is treated as a high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity item evaluated alongside insertion loss and crosstalk, because the raw source lists “IL/Xtalk/Eye diagram” under “Signal integrity flow of high speed PCB/PCBA.” [66]
Understanding it affects material/stackup selection decisions, because R&S PCB test solutions list Eye diagram together with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, and TL modeling under Material/Stackup selection for PCB Fabricator and System House [13].
Understanding it also affects high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity workflow decisions, because the R&S SerDes/SI/PI material lists IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator in the same signal-integrity flow [8][66].
Understanding it affects receiver/product validation decisions, because fiber-weave-induced intra-pair skew is stated to degrade the differential eye diagram seen by the receiver [9].
Understanding it affects PCIe redriver output acceptance decisions, because the source states that PCIe redriver output eye opening must be greater than or equal to the listed eye-opening values [10].
The cited PCIe context measures minimum eye width and eye height after equalization and before 3-tap DFE blocks [10].
In Rohde & Schwarz product-related context, R&S PCB test solutions cover material measurement, material/stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring for PCB Fabricator and System House [13][15].
R&S product mapping links R&S ZNA and R&S ZNB to PCB IL and TDR measurements, but the passages do not directly state an R&S product or option code specifically for eye-diagram measurement [27][29].
【推論】Because the raw SI flow places Eye diagram next to IL, Xtalk, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator, understanding the eye diagram helps decide whether the product-related measurement focus should be channel loss/crosstalk, impedance/TDR, or stackup/transmission-line modeling. [66]

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Eye opening requirements
| Generation | Extrapolated Eye Height after EQ | Minimum Eye Width after EQ | 來源 | 日期 |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| [[PCIe Gen3]] | 25 mV | 0.3 UI（37.5 ps） | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |
| [[PCIe Gen4]] | 15 ± 1.5 mV | 0.3 UI（18.75 ± 0.55 ps） | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |
| [[PCIe Gen5]] | 15 ± 1.5 mV | 0.3 UI（9.375 ± 0.5 ps） | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |

- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 minimum eye width 與 eye height 在 post-equalization、3-tap DFE blocks 之前量測。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 PCIe redriver output 的 eye opening 需要大於或等於表列 eye opening 數值。

In the provided evidence, an eye diagram is treated as a high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity item evaluated alongside insertion loss and crosstalk, because the raw source lists “IL/Xtalk/Eye diagram” under “Signal integrity flow of high speed PCB/PCBA.” [66]
Understanding it affects material/stackup selection decisions, because R&S PCB test solutions list Eye diagram together with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, and TL modeling under Material/Stackup selection for PCB Fabricator and System House [13].
Understanding it also affects high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity workflow decisions, because the R&S SerDes/SI/PI material lists IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator in the same signal-integrity flow [8][66].
Understanding it affects receiver/product validation decisions, because fiber-weave-induced intra-pair skew is stated to degrade the differential eye diagram seen by the receiver [9].
Understanding it affects PCIe redriver output acceptance decisions, because the source states that PCIe redriver output eye opening must be greater than or equal to the listed eye-opening values [10].
The cited PCIe context measures minimum eye width and eye height after equalization and before 3-tap DFE blocks [10].
In Rohde & Schwarz product-related context, R&S PCB test solutions cover material measurement, material/stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring for PCB Fabricator and System House [13][15].
R&S product mapping links R&S ZNA and R&S ZNB to PCB IL and TDR measurements, but the passages do not directly state an R&S product or option code specifically for eye-diagram measurement [27][29].
【推論】Because the raw SI flow places Eye diagram next to IL, Xtalk, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator, understanding the eye diagram helps decide whether the product-related measurement focus should be channel loss/crosstalk, impedance/TDR, or stackup/transmission-line modeling. [66]

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。
